register_fairseq2_extensions: create a function that discovers and registers all fairseq2.extension entry points into a DependencyContainer
handle_extension_type_errors: handle TypeError exceptions when an entry point has an invalid extension function signature
trace_extension_registration: enable extension registration tracing by setting the FAIRSEQ2_EXTENSION_TRACE environment variable
raise_extension_error: raise an ExtensionError with the entry point name and failure message when an extension fails to load
review_ExtensionError_class: review the ExtensionError class that stores the entry point name and message for extension loading failures
